root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand and leg crops. One huge, bulky, hairy bipedal hominoid (mande-barung-c02/c04). One head with a domed, cap-like mass of fur on the crown and no real hat (heads that looked as if they wore caps, c04), two amber eyes in a stern glare, and thick blackish-brown fur all over (c04). Two long arms: one hand grips a branch, the other hangs open near the slope; both are ape-like with a thumb and curled fingers, not malformed. Two legs: the front leg strides down the bank and the rear leg is in shadow behind. It strides down a steep, misty forested hillside at sunset (Garo Hills forest, Meghalaya, c01), with leaves and soil disturbed. The low camera and the leaning, glaring advance toward the viewer make it read as a menacing upright 'jungle man' (c03/c09), not an ordinary gorilla or a quadruped, and it dominates at 200px. No supernatural effect, text, aura or recognisable borrowed film design.
